approvers: Developer or main contractor (subcontract package), site manager
reason: Protection of glazing is specified in the subcontract package, so the developer or main contractor decides what is done and who pays. I have no budget line for this, and a 50% deposit on a supplier I don't know is not how I operate.
objection: We pay our suppliers at 60 to 90 days, not deposits up front. And at about 19 euro per m2 on top of a cheap film or cardboard, I can't pass that cost on unless the developer specifies it.
instead: Keep using cheap protection film, tape and cardboard, and repair or replace damaged glazing and joinery case by case, with the cost going to the party the subcontract says.
would_change_my_mind: A developer or main contractor writing it into the spec and paying for it, plus a local reference, and terms of 60 days with no deposit.
